One adjustment made for a bounded time.

nothing and the outcome says so rather than guessing a default.

print_time_s.description: How long the print has been running, in whole seconds.

state.description: The state the source reports the job to be in.

PlannedChange.description:
One stop the print's own G-code plans: an `M600` colour change or an
`M601` pause, where the firmware waits for a person.

color.description:
The colour loaded at it, as `#RRGGBB` in upper case, from the
`;COLOR_CHANGE,T<n>,#RRGGBB` line just before its `M600`; null for an
`M601`, and for an `M600` with no such line.

index.description: Its place among the file's changes, counting from 0 in file order.

kind.description: What it stops the print for.

layer.description:
The first layer printed after it, counting the first as 1: the layer
whose `;Z:` is the change's height.

offset_bytes.description: The byte offset of the first byte of its `M600` or `M601` line.

PlannedChangeKind.description: What a planned change stops the print for.

oneOf.description: An `M600`: the firmware stops so a person can load the next colour.
An `M601`: the firmware pauses until a person resumes it.

PlannedChanges.description: A print's planned changes as the status read answers them.

changes.description: Every change the file plans, in file order.

expected_color.description:
The colour expected at the job's current position, as `#RRGGBB`; null
when the file names none there or the position is unknown.

segments.description: The stretches between them, in file order.

waiting.description:
The index of the change the printer is waiting at now; null when it is
waiting at none.

PlannedSegment.description: One stretch of the print between its planned changes.

color.description:
Its colour as `#RRGGBB`: segment 0's the file's `filament_colour`, every
later one its change's; null where the file names none.

filament_mm.description: The filament it feeds, in millimetres: the net of its extrusion moves.

segment.description:
Its number: segment 0 runs from the file's start to change 0, and
segment n from change n-1 to change n, or to the file's end.

PrintId.description: A lowercase hyphenated version 7 UUID identifying one print.

PrintRecord.description:
One print, and the record supervision keys from.

The provider's own print id is carried beside this record's identifier
rather than as it, because a print may be observed before the provider
that reports it has one.

end_reason.description: Why it ended, if it has.

ended_at.description: When it ended, if it has.

file_name.description: The file being printed, as the source reported it.

id.description: This print's identifier, minted by the store.

job_print_time_s.description:
The longest running time, in whole seconds, the printer reported for
this print's job at a read that found it printing rather than paused.

The time a job has spent printing only grows, pause or no pause, so a
job of this print's file reporting less — by more than
`listing::JOB_IDENTITY_TOLERANCE_S` — is a later job. Absent until a
read finds the job printing.

job_started_at.description:
When the printer's job this print records began, as the printer's own
running time put it at the latest read that found the job running or
paused: the instant of that read, less the running time it reported.

`OctoPrint` counts a pause into the running time until the job resumes
and then takes the pause back out, so a pause moves this later: a read
putting it further than `listing::JOB_IDENTITY_TOLERANCE_S` from the one
recorded resets it, rather than it being fixed once. Absent when no read has
found this print's job reporting a running time — a print opened by an
alert or a start before any read, and every print recorded before this
was.

narrowings.description: Every manifest range this print narrowed to the envelope's.

provider_print_id.description:
The provider's own identifier for the print, whichever provider
reported it, when one has.

state.description: The state the print is in.

bed.description: The bed heater, when the printer reports one.

chamber.description: The chamber heater, when the printer reports one.
